hint: Something was added to $x$ to make $15$. Which operation undoes adding?
explanation: The equation $x + 7 = 15$ says that adding $7$ to $x$ gives $15$.
Subtraction undoes addition, so subtract $7$ from both sides to keep the equation balanced: $x + 7 - 7 = 15 - 7$.
The left side is now just $x$ and the right side is $8$, so $x = 8$.
Check by putting it back: $8 + 7 = 15$, which is true. The solution is $x = 8$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Think: "what plus 7 is 15?"
steps: The equation asks: some number plus $7$ equals $15$.

hints.text: Something was added to $x$ to make $15$. Which operation undoes adding?
Subtract $7$ from both sides so that $x$ is alone. On the right you need to work out $15 - 7$.
$15 - 7 = 8$, so the solution of the equation is $x = 8$.
